readerCopy.headline: Someone else may need more at the exact moment you do.
readerCopy.body:
Someone close may suddenly need more of your time. You may want to be there and still have work in the morning, an appointment you cannot move, or a quiet evening you were counting on. The tension does not require anyone to be unreasonable. Two real needs can still be trying to use the same hours.

Jupiter opposing Moon can enlarge giving and receiving at the same time. Decide what you can actually do before care turns into a promise you cannot keep without taking from yourself somewhere else. Help can be loving and still need a limit.
doNotAssume: Do not assume caregiving, illness, family conflict, or that another person's need is excessive.
